title: Bun SQLite leaderboard
context: Leaderboard on bun:sqlite. A player's best score is kept; a lower new score must not overwrite it. Rank 1 is the highest score and tied players share a rank. order may only be "asc" or "desc"; limit is 1-100. Only the game server (x-game-key header equal to GAME_KEY) submits scores.
code: db.run("CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS scores (player TEXT PRIMARY KEY, score INTEGER NOT NULL, updated_at INTEGER NOT NULL)");
"INSERT INTO scores (player, score, updated_at) VALUES (?1, ?2, ?3) ON CONFLICT(player) DO UPDATE SET score = excluded.score, updated_at = excluded.updated_at",
const scoreOf = db.query("SELECT score FROM scores WHERE player = ?");
const higherThan = db.query("SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM scores WHERE score >= ?");
return GAME_KEY.length > 0 && a.length === b.length && timingSafeEqual(a, b);
return db.query(`SELECT player, score FROM scores ORDER BY score ${order} LIMIT ?`).all(limit);
if (typeof player !== "string" || !Number.isSafeInteger(score) || score < 0) return new Response("bad score", { status: 400 });
const row = scoreOf.get(player) as { score: number } | null;
if (!row) return new Response("unknown player", { status: 404 });
const { n } = higherThan.get(row.score) as { n: number };

expected.why: always overwrites, so a lower score replaces the player's best; needs WHERE excluded.score > scores.score
>= counts the player and everyone tied with them, so rank = n + 1 is too low by at least one and ties do not share a rank; must be >
order is interpolated unchecked into the SQL text (injection); it must be validated against asc/desc
a negative limit is kept, and LIMIT -1 means no limit in SQLite, so one request dumps the whole table; clamp to at least 1
